scripts.javacore:stop: powershell -Command "$conn = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 8080,5005 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($conn) { $conn | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Host 'Stopped javacore processes.' } else { Write-Host 'No running javacore processes found.' }"
